design: Retrospective descriptive extension of the MapBiomas land cover comparison. Protocol written before this extension was executed, after E1-E10 were known.
versions: V1: soil collection 3 and land cover 7.1
V2: soil collection 3 and land cover 10
stock: sum of soil mean times mapped area within each class
net_relative: abs(sum class differences) / previous total stock
class_relative: sum abs(class differences) / previous total stock
offsetting_relative: (sum abs(class differences) - abs(sum class differences)) / (2 times previous total stock)
missed_by_total_summary: class_alert is true and total_only_alert is false
interpretation: An alert marks a version difference, not an error in the source or a measured environmental change. Gross class differences count positive and negative terms. Offsetting differences are an arithmetic quantity, not evidence of carbon transport.
validation: Compare national 2021 net change and largest class changes to E7 rounded records. Reconcile source totals before threshold counts.
scope: Finite set from the supplied extracts. Municipality-year comparisons are not independent samples. No significance test or claim of transfer to other products.
